title: Fix Android (Clang) build errors in the interruption subsystem and the sandbox game mode
acceptance: Android arm64 Development build compiles with zero errors
description: Found packaging T-0006: Clang's -Wunreachable-code-loop-increment (an error on Android) rejects the 'for (...) return first;' pattern used to pick the first actor. MSVC accepts it, so the Windows editor build and tests never caught it. Widened to the sandbox files (T-0053 is in review) after the first completion was recorded with the wrong commit; that completion is superseded.

result.summary: Android (Clang) build fixes on the T-0053 branch: the sandbox uses ALight::GetLightComponent (ADirectionalLight::GetComponent is editor-only), and three one-pass 'first actor' loops (sandbox ShouldBuildSandbox, interruption FindRig and BindMenuButton) became single iterator checks, since Clang's -Wunreachable-code-loop-increment is an error on Android. Supersedes the earlier completion, which named the wrong commit.
result.verification: Android arm64 Development C++ compiles (the build reaches Gradle, which then fails on Java 25: a toolchain issue, not code). Editor build clean; all 78 ETM tests pass.
result.remaining: Packaging needs JDK 21 (T-0006). Merge with T-0053 (same branch).
